programs.title: Bananas in Pyjamas
programs.desc: The Bananas aren't well so the Dr Teddies advise them to stay in bed for the day. They feel better after a sleep but as they have to stay in bed, they call on Rat's home delivery service.

programs.title: Bing
programs.desc: Pando and Sula sit in the Fire Engine but when it's Bing's turn; it leaves! Flop, Amma, Sula and Bing walk to Bing's house where Arlo is stuck on the neighbour's roof! Bing must help him get down.

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Fizzy and Suds ride tractors of all sizes! They watch huge wheels, harvest wheat in neat rows, and see a tractor pull a stuck vehicle out of mud - a mighty tractor rescue on the farm!

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.desc: Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where at first they think all the stuff to do is scary, but Grampy Rabbit tells the kids about how he explored a jungle, helping the kids get over their fears.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.sub_title: The Wiggly Days Of The Week
programs.desc: Join Evie and Dorothy for some graceful 'Row, Row, Row Your Boat Ballet.' Then embark on a week-long journey to explore the days of the week, discover the surprises each day brings, making it full of exciting adventures!

programs.title: Shaun the Sheep
programs.desc: Leis na caoraich a-mach airson spòrs tha Bitzer a' coimhead às dèidh Timmy. Ach chan fhada gus am bheil e follaiseach cò aig tha làmh an uachdair. The flock are off for a girls' night, leaving Bitzer to Babysit Timmy. However, it isn't not long before the youngster makes clear who's in charge.
